integrity: Finite computational replay is corroboration, not an infinite or independently audited proof. The theorem has a self-contained mathematical argument that does not depend on finite experiments; historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: The finite inequalities and the fixed-m quadratic coefficient are proved; exact lower-order terms and regimes with growing m are unresolved. Possible unpublished related work on token domination and Turan numbers was not compared in full.
title: Quadratic domination growth in three-token complete bipartite graphs
